interpretation_note: nx.gnp.algebraic_connectivity_sequence does not exist in networkx 3.6.1; the greedy Fiedler rule of Newman (2007) is re-implemented in this file (dense symmetric eigensolve, normalised Laplacian, remove min |v_i| each step). It is a NODE removal order, so it is the algebraic-connectivity analogue of the GN edge-cut hierarchy, not identical to it.
